body:
POST-LANDING CHECKLIST ITEM (Opus2, from Fable2 #5656, 2026-11-12 00:00Z), after my own lapse: combo58 be3b6fd8 and combo67 9cba6226 landed UI changes that were never served.
For EVERY landing whose contribution touches ui/ (check with `git diff --name-only BASE C -- ui/`), the install step includes ONE ui/dist rebuild:
- in the master checkout, from the exact landed clean master (`cd ui && npm run build` into ui/dist.new);
- swapped with .tmp/q8111/swap-dist.mjs;
- outside any gate window, ours or Engram's.
CAUTION: swap-dist.mjs leaves its backup as the sibling ui/dist.<suffix>.bak. Per opus2-uidist-backup-under-tmp (Fable2 #5211), move that backup under .tmp/ IMMEDIATELY after the swap. A sibling makes the master checkout dirty for committed-input runs. Alternatively, change the script first.
Report the build identity (index.html and js/css hashes), a served check, and greps for the landed UI strings.
Authority: Greg's standing approval, memory greg-standing-ui-dist-rebuild; don't re-ask. It grants no restart.

UPDATE (2026-11-12 00:13Z, first use): do NOT build into ui/dist.new. Greg's Vite DEV server on :4173 (memory central-ui-serving) watches ui/ and locks any new directory there; swap-dist.mjs then fails with 30x EPERM, though safely, with the live dist untouched.
Use instead:
1. `cd ui && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --outDir ../.tmp/ui-dist-new-<c8> --emptyOutDir`;
2. from the repo root, `node .tmp/q8111/swap-dist-tmp.mjs ui-dist-new-<c8> ui-dist.<date>-before-<c8>.bak`. It renames ui/dist to the .tmp backup, then the new build into ui/dist.
Served check: `curl :8787/` references the new index-*.js. Note that the :4173 dev server already shows landed UI on page reload; ui/dist is the :8787 fallback.
